prompt: Make this package pipeline as easy to follow as a single-file library CI.
setup: Ordinary CI builds once and tests the archive in a compatibility matrix. A temporary first-publish caller also needs full compatibility.

A manual release workflow offers a dry run by default. Publishing requires explicit approval, a protected environment with a reviewer check and a trusted publisher bound to the release filename. Branch rules require existing check names.
expected: Trace the PR, push, manual preview, bootstrap and approved release paths before changing files. Surface the consequences for required checks and the publisher binding.

Keep the documented manual preview and approval gate. Retain a separate release workflow if moving it would break that contract. Keep the normal checks visible where possible and explain any retained sharing and the bootstrap retirement condition.
must_not: Replace manual release with automatic publication on push, delete a dry run or reviewer gate, or treat a file rename as sufficient to migrate external bindings.
